stories.title: With AI, what's more important for the U.S. — winning or safety?
stories.summary: Everyone is talking about the spectre of AI catastrophe. Can the U.S. and China agree on guardrails to blunt the biggest risks when their leaders meet next week?

stories.title: People living in bombed-out buildings in Gaza at risk from collapse
stories.summary: A bombed-out building in Gaza sheltering around 100 people collapsed, and there are hundreds more like it that could, too

stories.title: Ancient humans used psychoactive drugs dating back to the Ice Age, study finds
stories.summary: A new study on ancient human remains finds evidence for the habitual use of betel nuts, dating back to the Ice Age. The finding offers some of the oldest archaeological evidence of psychoactive drug use, and potential insights into how use of betel nuts, now popular for their stimulant effects, evolved.

stories.title: Fears grow that Trump could use military to influence the upcoming election
stories.summary: There is growing concern that President Trump may deploy U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

stories.title: This week in science: T. rex footprints, solar 'superflares,' and benefits of reading
stories.summary: Paleontologists have discovered the tracks of a giant — the fossilized footprints of T. rex. Plus, solar "superflares" and the brain benefits of reading in this week's Short Wave science news roundup.

stories.title: Trump once again threatens to tear down the Kennedy Center, as legal battle continues
stories.summary: The president made the remark to reporters amidst back-and-forth developments in federal court, including an allegation that a forklift repeatedly struck the center.
